title: Rakh Bagh, Ludhiana: A Green Escape in the Heart of the City
content:
Rakh Bagh Ludhiana - A Complete Travel & Visitor Guide

Rakh Bagh is a well-maintained urban park developed by the Municipal Corporation of Ludhiana, Punjab. It is often referred to as the “green lung” of the city due to its large open spaces and dense tree cover. The park is a favorite spot for locals for daily walks, yoga, jogging, and spending quality time with family and friends.

Location and Accessibility

  • Location: Near Civil Lines, Ludhiana, Punjab
  • Nearest Railway Station: Ludhiana Junction (approx. 3 km)
  • Nearest Airport: Sahnewal Airport, Ludhiana (approx. 15 km)
  • Road Connectivity: Easily accessible by auto, cab, and local buses

Things to Do at Rakh Bagh

  • Morning and Evening Walks : The park has long, well-paved walking and jogging tracks, making it ideal for fitness enthusiasts.
  • Yoga and Exercise : Many people visit Rakh Bagh early in the morning for yoga, meditation, and light exercises in a calm environment.
  •  Family Time & Picnics: With open lawns and shaded areas, it is a great place for families and children to relax and play.
  •  Photography and Nature Time :The greenery, seasonal flowers, and peaceful surroundings make it perfect for photography and nature lovers.

Best Time to Visit

  • Best Season: October to March (pleasant weather)
  • Best Time of Day: Early morning or evening

Avoid visiting during peak afternoon hours in summer due to heat.

Entry Fee and Timings

  • Entry Fee: Free
  • Timings: 

Morning: 5:00 AM - 9:00 AM Evening: 4:00 PM - 8:00 PM
(Timings may vary slightly by season)

Why Rakh Bagh is Special

  • Clean and well-maintained park
  • Peaceful atmosphere despite being in the city
  • Ideal for health, relaxation, and family outings
  • One of the oldest and most loved parks in Ludhiana

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Nehru Rose Garden
  • Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Campus  
  • Ghumar Mandi Market
excerpt: Rakh Bagh is a perfect example of how green spaces can improve city life. It offers fresh air, peace, and a break from daily stress. If you are in Ludhiana and want to spend some calm moments in nature, Rakh Bagh is definitely worth a visit

faqs.question: Where is Rakh Bagh located in Ludhiana?
faqs.answer: Rakh Bagh is located in the Civil Lines area of Ludhiana, Punjab. It is easily accessible by road and is close to major city landmarks.

faqs.question: What are the timings of Rakh Bagh Ludhiana?
faqs.answer: Rakh Bagh is usually open in the morning from 5:00 AM to 9:00 AM and in the evening from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Timings may vary by season.

faqs.question: Is there any entry fee for Rakh Bagh Park?
faqs.answer: No, entry to Rakh Bagh Ludhiana is completely free for all visitors.

faqs.question: Are pets allowed inside Rakh Bagh Park?
faqs.answer: Pets are generally not allowed inside Rakh Bagh to maintain cleanliness and safety.

faqs.question: Is Rakh Bagh good for morning walks and jogging?
faqs.answer: Yes, Rakh Bagh is one of the best parks in Ludhiana for morning walks, jogging, yoga, and light exercise due to its clean walking tracks and peaceful environment.
